text:
sara-cs: @jess-support Escalation from Acme Payments — their project tile shows "Available: -120 tokens" for the rolling 24h quota starting 00:00 UTC. They say invoice looks normal but dashboard shows negative available and they've hit hard 429s. Can someone triage? :warning:

jess-support: Thanks Sara. I asked for screenshots + project id. Customer provided project: proj-acme-pay-42. Screenshot attached: tile shows -120, and the per-project limit still set to 100k. They say it flipped negative right after daily rollover (~00:00 UTC).

matt-eng: pinging infra. Quick hypothesis: double-counting at UTC boundary due to timezone vs rolling-window cutover. We saw a similar edge case in staging with DST. Can you send repro steps?

sara-cs: Repro steps from customer: 1) make bursts of requests between 23:55-00:05 UTC, 2) wait for dashboard refresh (they used Console -> Usage -> Project tiles), 3) observe tile show negative available. They also saw 429s for requests that should have been within quota.

jess-support: I ran quick query against metering logs for proj-acme-pay-42:
```
SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS minute, sum(tokens) FROM usage WHERE project_id='proj-acme-pay-42' AND ts >= '2026-03-14T23:50:00Z' AND ts < '2026-03-15T00:15:00Z' GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute;
```
Result: spikes around 23:59:00 and again at 00:00:00 with very similar counts — looks like an ingestion replay dedupe missed one shard.

usage-agg-bot: Recalculated aggregates for project proj-acme-pay-42 at 2026-03-15T00:20:15Z. Old rolling-window total: 100,120 tokens. New rolling-window total: 100,000 tokens. Dashboard cache invalidated for that tile.

riak-billing: Billing checked — invoice used cumulative metering, not the live rolling tile. Invoice matches backend ledger (100,000 tokens) so customer was not overbilled. Confirmed there was a short-lived double-counting in the real-time tile only.

matt-eng: Root cause: race during the midnight compaction where shard A and shard B both fed the aggregator; one path failed to set the `dedup_mark` due to a GC delay. Fix: add idempotency marker at ingestion plus a recovery job to reconcile last-hour aggregates at UTC rollover. I'll open a rollout PR and a hotfix job to patch the tile cache.

sara-cs: Shared the update with the customer: explained negative tile is a dashboard artifact, no billing impact, 429s were symptomatic and should stop after cache invalidation. Customer is relieved but asked for small postmortem and timeline.

jess-support: Action items: 1) matt-eng to submit PR + patch job (ETA 4h), 2) riak-billing to verify no ledger deltas (done), 3) support to send postmortem and offer one-time credit if customer still concerned. Marking thread :eyes:.
